tracking.title: Get tracking you can trust.
tracking.intro: Many charities end up with several Google Analytics properties, tag containers nobody has touched in years and agencies measuring their own results. Then nobody can say which campaigns raise money. Andrew audits the setup, removes what's dead or duplicated and sets up conversion tracking that works.

story.text: Oxfam Ireland had GA4 properties for its main site, its donation platform, its Shopify store and old test sites, plus Tag Manager containers that hadn't been updated in about five years. Andrew audited the lot, flagged what was outdated, duplicated or inactive, recommended a simpler structure and set up the GA4 conversions that matter for campaigns.

faq.q: Is ad spend included in the price?
faq.a: No. You pay Google or Meta directly for your ads. Andrew's fee covers the work of planning, running and reporting on them.
No, all prices are plus VAT.

faq.q: Who owns the ad and analytics accounts?
faq.a: You do. Everything is set up in your organisation's name, and you keep the logins when the work ends.

faq.q: Who will I actually work with?
faq.a: Andrew, directly. There are no account managers or juniors.

faq.q: Can you manage our Google Ad Grant?
faq.a: Yes. Andrew manages both paid Google Ads and Google Ad Grants.

faq.q: Do you only work with charities?
faq.a: Mostly charities and non-profits, but also social enterprises and purpose-led businesses.

faq.q: Can you train our team instead?
faq.a: Yes. Andrew runs half-day, hands-on workshops. See the training page.
